mentions.name: Rudys.AI
mentions.description: This tool manages Google Ads campaigns with AI-driven automation. For search campaigns, it automatically crawls a website to identify offerings and generates new campaigns, and provides qualitative recommendations such as relevant terms to include or exclude (including typos as keywords) and landing page improvements. For shopping campaigns, it smartly labels products as Top performers, Rising, or Ghost to allocate budget across multiple campaigns, doubling down on what works instead of draining a single budget across thousands of products.
mentions.problem: Managing large Google Ads campaigns manually is inefficient: shopping campaigns with thousands of products under one budget drain spend instead of concentrating it on top performers.
